## Experience

**Currently**

- Part-time technician at [Applied Epi](https://www.appliedepi.org), supporting training for frontline epidemiologists.

**Previously**

- Community building and training at [Epiverse-TRACE](https://data.org/initiatives/epiverse/), developing tutorials and how-to guides for outbreak analytics.
- Developed and organised the short course on [outbreak analytics and applied modelling in R](https://www.lshtm.ac.uk/study/courses/short-courses/outbreaks-analytics-R) at the London School of Hygiene & Tropical Medicine (LSHTM).
- Author of a [geospatial visualization](https://thegraphcourses.org/courses/geospatial-viz/) lesson with R for The GRAPH Network.
- Consultant in epidemiological research and surveillance at the [National Center for Epidemiology (CDC Peru)](https://www.dge.gob.pe/), including COVID-19 transmission and seroprevalence analyses.

## Education

- **MSc** in Epidemiological Research (UPCH, 2018), with a thesis project on [human mobility and malaria history](https://github.com/avallecam/movmal) in the Peruvian Amazon.
- **BSc** in Genetics and Biotechnology (UNMSM, 2015), with a thesis project on [antibody responses in severe vivax malaria](https://github.com/avallecam/abnomic) using protein microarrays.
- Trained in **scientific computing** for genetics and biotech, and in **applied statistics** for epidemiology.

## Skills

- Proficient **`R` user**, expert `tidy` data **wrangler** and `ggplot2` **visualization** enthusiast.
- Fluent with `bash` for **automation**, `ssh` for **remote** computing, and `shiny` for reactive **dashboards**.
- Experience building **statistical workflows** with omic, serological, GPS, health service, and outbreak **spatio-temporal** data.
- Further training through these communities: [ICTP-SAIFR](https://www.ictp-saifr.org/v-southern-summer-school-on-mathematical-biology/), [CODATA-RDA](https://www.datascienceschools.org/), [RECON](https://www.repidemicsconsortium.org/), [MetaDocencia](https://www.metadocencia.org/cursos/), [The Carpentries](https://carpentries.github.io/instructor-training/).
